As Muhammad told us, he said: Ahmad told us, he said: Asbat told us, on the authority of Al-Suddi, regarding his statement, So fear God, O you of understanding, he said: O you of intellects. And His saying: Those who believed means: those who believed in God and His Messengers. And His statement: God has sent down to you a reminder * a Messenger. The people of interpretation differed regarding the meaning of the reminder and the Messenger in this place. Some of them said: The reminder is the Qur’an, and the Messenger is Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Who said that? Muhammad told us, he said: Ahmad told us, he said: Asbat told us, on the authority of Al-Suddi, regarding his statement, God has sent down to you a reminder * a Messenger, he said: The reminder is the Qur’an, and the Messenger is Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace. Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us, he said: Ibn Zayd said, regarding the statement of God Almighty, God has sent down to you a message, he said: The Qur’an is a spirit from God. And he recited, And thus We have revealed to you a spirit of Our command (al-Shura 42:52), to the end of the verse. And he recited, God has sent down to you a message * A Messenger, he said: The Qur’an. And he recited, Indeed, those who disbelieved in the message when it came to them (Fussilat 41:41), he said: With the Qur’an. And he recited, Indeed, it is We who sent down the message (al-Hijr 15:9), he said: The Qur’an. He said: And it is the message, and it is the spirit. Others said: The male is the Messenger. The correct thing to say about this is that the Messenger is a translation of the male, and this is an accusative because it is returned to him for the explanation and translation of it. The interpretation of the statement then is: God has sent down to you, O people of understanding, a reminder from God to you, reminding you of it and alerting you to your share of faith in God and working to obey Him, a Messenger who recites to you the verses of God that God sent down to him.
65:11: Mubinat He says: Mubinat to whoever hears it and ponders it that it is from God. God Almighty says: God has sent down to you, O people, a reminder and a Messenger, reciting to you clear verses, in order that He may bring forth those who believed in God and His Messenger and did righteous deeds, from darkness to light, meaning from disbelief, which is darkness, to light, meaning to faith. And His statement: And whoever believes in God and does righteousness means: And whoever believes in God and works in obedience to Him. He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow means: He will admit him to orchards beneath whose trees rivers flow. Therein to abide forever means: They will remain and reside in the orchards beneath which rivers flow forever. They will never die and will never leave them. His saying: God has given him a good provision means: God has given him a good provision in Paradise. By provision, he means: what He has given him in it of food and drink, and everything else that He has prepared for His friends in it, and He has made it good for them.
65:12: God Almighty says: God is He who created seven heavens, not the gods and idols that the polytheists worship, which are unable to create anything. His saying, And from the earth the like of them, means: And He created from the earth the like of them, because in each one of them is the like of what is in the heavens of creation. Who said that? Amr ibn Ali and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna told me: Muhammad ibn Ja`far told us: Shu`bah told us, on the authority of Amr ibn Murrah, on the authority of Abu al-Dhaha, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said regarding this verse: God is He who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them. Amr said: He said in every earth there is the like of Abraham and the like of what is on the earth of creation. Ibn al-Muthanna said: In every heaven there is Abraham. Amr bin Ali told us, he said: Waki’ told us, he said: Al-A’mash told us, on the authority of Ibrahim bin Muhajir, on the authority of Mujahid, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, regarding his statement, Seven heavens and of the earth the like of them, he said: If I told you its interpretation, you would disbelieve, and your disbelief is your denial of it. Abu Kurayb told us: Abu Kurayb told us, on the authority of Asim, on the authority of Zur, on the authority of Abdullah, who said: God created seven heavens, the thickness of each one is a journey of five hundred years, and between each one of them is five hundred years, and above the seven heavens is the water, and God, may His praise be glorified, is above the water, nothing of the deeds of the children of Adam is hidden from Him, and the earth is seven, between every two earths is five hundred years, and the thickness of each earth is five hundred years. Ibn Hamid told us: Yaqub ibn Abdullah ibn Sa`d al-Qummi al-Ash`ari told us, on the authority of Ja`far ibn Abi al-Mughira al-Khuza`i, on the authority of Sa`id ibn Jubayr, who said: A man said to Ibn Abbas, God is He who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them... the verse. Ibn Abbas said, What assures you that I will not tell you about it and you will disbelieve? He said: Abbas told us, on the authority of Anbasa, on the authority of Layth, on the authority of Mujahid, who said: This land to that is like a tent that I pitched in a desert, and this sky to that sky is like a ring that I threw in a desert. Ibn Hamid told us: Hakam told us, on the authority of Abu Ja`far, on the authority of Al-Rabi` bin Anas, who said: The first part of the sky is a restrained wave, the second is rock, the third is iron, the fourth is copper, the fifth is silver, the sixth is gold, and the seventh is a ruby. Yunus told me, he said: Ibn Wahb told us, he said: Jarir bin Hazim told us, he said: Hamid bin Qais told us, on the authority of Mujahid, he said: This house, the Kaaba, is the fourth of fourteen houses, in each heaven there is a house, each house of them is in line with its companion, if it were to fall on it, and this sanctuary is the most sacred of its constructions from the seven heavens and earths. Bishr told us, he said: Yazid told us, he said: Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada, his statement, God is He who created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them, He created seven heavens and seven earths, in each heaven is one of His heavens and an earth is one of His earths, a creation of His creation, a command of His command, and a decree of His decree. Ibn Abd al-A’la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, who said: “While the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sitting once with his companions, a cloud passed by. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘Do you know what this is?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘This is the reins. These are the waters of the earth which God drives to a people who do not worship Him.’ He said: ‘Do you know what this sky is?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘This sky is a restrained wave and a protected ceiling.’ Then he said: ‘Do you know what is above that?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘Above that is another sky,’ until he enumerated seven heavens, and he said: ‘Do you know what is between them is five hundred years?’ Then he said: ‘Do you know what is above that?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘Above that is the Throne.’ He said: ‘Do you know what this earth is?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘Under that is an earth.’ He said: ‘Do you know how much is between them?’ They said: ‘God and His Messenger know best.’ He said: ‘Between them is a journey of five hundred years,’ until he enumerated seven earths. Then he said: By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if a man were to be let down by a rope until he reached the bottom of the seventh earth, he would descend upon God. Then he said: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Hidden, and He is Knowing of all things. Ibn Abd al-A'la told us: Ibn Thawr told us, on the authority of Muammar, on the authority of Qatada, who said: Four angels met between heaven and earth, and some of them said to each other: Where did you come from? One of them said: My Lord sent me from the seventh heaven and I left him. Then the other said: My Lord sent me from the seventh earth and I left him. Then the third said: My Lord sent me from the east and I left him. Then the third said: My Lord sent me from the west and I left him. And His saying: “The command descends between them” means that God Almighty says: God’s command descends between the seventh heaven and the seventh earth. Muhammad bin Amr told me, he said: Abu Asim told us, he said: Isa told us, and Al-Harith told me, he said: Al-Hasan told us, he said: Warqa’ told us, both of them, on the authority of Ibn Abi Nujayh, on the authority of Mujahid, regarding his statement, The command descends between them, he said: between the seventh earth and the seventh heaven. And His statement: So that you may know that God has power over all things. God Almighty says: God’s decree and command descend between that so that you may know, O people, the essence of His power and authority, and that nothing He wills is impossible for Him, and nothing He wills is prevented from Him, but that He has power over whatever He wills. And that God has encompassed all things in knowledge. God Almighty says: So that you may know, O people, that God has encompassed all things of His creation in knowledge. Not an atom’s weight on earth or in heaven escapes Him, nor anything smaller or larger. God Almighty says: So fear, O people who disobey the command of your Lord, His punishment, for nothing can prevent Him from punishing you, and He is Able to do that. He also encompasses your deeds, and nothing of them is hidden from Him, and He is keeping account of them from you in order to reward you for them, on the Day when every soul will be recompensed for what it has earned.
